{{Quote|I've seen Imperial cruisers destroyed in the Nebulas of Osssorck; fought my way through the dust storms of Voniss; stared down Dark Grahn's mercenary army; now, all I can stare down is the bottom of a bottle of cheap wine, kid.|A gunfighter|<ref name="AFoC" />}}
'''Voniss''' was an astronomical object<ref name="AFoC" /> located in the [[Voniss system/Legends|Voniss system]], a part of the [[Freestanding subsectors/Legends|freestanding subsectors]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The meteorological phenomena of the celestial body included [[Sandstorm/Legends|dust storms]].<ref name="AFoC" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an aging yet legendary [[Unidentified gunfighter|gunfighter]] resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Buerhoz]] on the<ref name="AFoC" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']]<ref name="EAOC Clakdor">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Colu system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. When a group of individuals encountered the gunfighter at Buerhoz, he claimed to have fought his way through the dust storms of Voniss.<ref name="AFoC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voniss was mentioned in "[[A Fistful of Credits]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure written by [[Bill Olmesdahl]] and included in the [[1992]] supplement ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="AFoC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Voniss [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square I-7.<ref name="TEA" />
